mapper.select: SELECT (CASE job WHEN 1 THEN '班主任' WHEN 2 THEN '讲师' WHEN 3 THEN '学工主管' WHEN 4 THEN '教研主管' WHEN 5 THEN '咨询师' ELSE '其他' END) AS jobName, COUNT(*) AS num FROM emp WHERE job IS NOT NULL GROUP BY job ORDER BY job

SELECT (CASE degree WHEN 1 THEN '初中' WHEN 2 THEN '高中' WHEN 3 THEN '大专' WHEN 4 THEN '本科' WHEN 5 THEN '硕士' WHEN 6 THEN '博士' ELSE '其他' END) AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM student WHERE degree IS NOT NULL GROUP BY degree ORDER BY degree

SELECT c.id AS clazzId, c.name AS clazzName, c.room AS room, IFNULL(e.name, '未分配') AS masterName, COUNT(s.id) AS studentCount FROM clazz c LEFT JOIN emp e ON c.master_id = e.id LEFT JOIN student s ON s.clazz_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.room, e.name ORDER BY studentCount DESC, c.id

SELECT c.id AS clazzId, c.name AS clazzName, c.end_date AS endDate, DATEDIFF(c.end_date, CURDATE()) AS remainDays, IFNULL(e.name, '未分配') AS masterName, COUNT(s.id) AS studentCount FROM clazz c LEFT JOIN emp e ON c.master_id = e.id LEFT JOIN student s ON s.clazz_id = c.id WHERE c.end_date BETWEEN CURDATE() AND DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.end_date, e.name ORDER BY c.end_date ASC

SELECT s.id AS studentId, s.name AS studentName, s.no AS studentNo, IFNULL(c.name, '未分配') AS clazzName, s.violation_count AS violationCount, s.violation_score AS violationScore FROM student s LEFT JOIN clazz c ON s.clazz_id = c.id WHERE s.violation_score > 0 ORDER BY s.violation_score DESC, s.violation_count DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT s.id AS studentId, s.name AS studentName, s.no AS studentNo, s.phone AS phone, IFNULL(c.name, '未分配') AS clazzName, s.violation_count AS violationCount, s.violation_score AS violationScore FROM student s LEFT JOIN clazz c ON s.clazz_id = c.id WHERE s.violation_score >= 5 OR s.violation_count >= 3 ORDER BY s.violation_score DESC, s.violation_count DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT e.id AS masterId, e.name AS masterName, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS clazzCount, COUNT(s.id) AS studentCount FROM emp e LEFT JOIN clazz c ON c.master_id = e.id LEFT JOIN student s ON s.clazz_id = c.id WHERE e.job = 1 GROUP BY e.id, e.name ORDER BY studentCount DESC
